key_insight: FlowMoP jointly predicts diverse, socially conditioned 3D motion futures for multiple people rather than a single deterministic continuation.
engineering_relevance: Distributional motion forecasts can support uncertainty-aware planning in systems that interact with moving people.
method: Conditional flow matching generates joint futures for global trajectories and root-relative poses.
B-spline reparameterization compresses the generative state and enforces temporal smoothness.
A dual-stream transformer conditions predictions on observed neighbor motion.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art joint position, pose, and final displacement errors on CMU-Mocap (UMPM) and 3DPW, plus the first motion prediction baseline on WorldPose soccer data.
watch_item: Real-time sampling cost and uncertainty calibration are not established by the abstract.
